title: Vertiv completes acquisition of King Environmental Services Ltd., expanding global fluid management services
summary: Vertiv Holdings Co. (NYSE: VRT), a global leader in critical digital infrastructure, today announced it has completed its acquisition of King Environmental Services Ltd. (KES), a Europe-based provider of fluid management, commissioning and load-testing services for high-density, liquid-cooled data centers.
body_markdown:
KES's fluid management, commissioning and load-testing expertise builds on Vertiv's North American capabilities established through its PurgeRite acquisition


COLUMBUS, Ohio


\[October 26, 2026\] — Vertiv Holdings Co. (NYSE: VRT), a global leader in critical digital infrastructure, today announced it has completed its acquisition of King Environmental Services Ltd. (KES), a Europe-based provider of fluid management, commissioning and load-testing services for high-density, liquid-cooled data centers.


The acquisition expands Vertiv's global thermal management services capabilities into Europe, Middle East and Africa (EMEA) and advances its strategy to support customers across the thermal chain. The transaction builds on Vertiv's established North American fluid management presence, including its 2025 acquisition of PurgeRite, and represents the next step in expanding its global thermal and fluid management services platform.


"We are pleased to welcome the KES team to Vertiv," said Giordano Albertazzi, Chief Executive Officer of Vertiv. "As computing density increases, the performance of cooling infrastructure depends not only on engineering and system design but on execution in the field. KES builds on the Vertiv fluid management foundation, extending our specialized expertise and disciplined execution into EMEA as customers deploy increasingly complex infrastructure at scale."


The Vertiv and KES combination expands Vertiv’s end-to-end thermal management capabilities enabling our customers to:


- Reduce operational complexity


through a single accountable partner for commissioning, testing, fluid management and ongoing operations,
- Improve cooling system performance


with clean, balanced and validated fluid systems that support optimal heat transfer and equipment efficiency,
- Maintain compliance


with regional fluid handling, treatment and disposal requirements, and
- Increase confidence in infrastructure readiness


through thermal load testing before facilities enter operation.


KES is headquartered near Dublin, Ireland, and serves customers across the EMEA region. The financial terms were not disclosed and are not expected to be material to Vertiv's financial results.


For more information about Vertiv's portfolio of power and thermal management products, infrastructure solutions, IT systems and services for critical digital applications, visit[Vertiv.com](https://www.vertiv.com/en-us/) .


### About Vertiv Holdings Co.


Vertiv Holdings Co. (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers’ vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs.


Vertiv solves the most important challenges facing today’s


data centers, communication networks and commercial and industrial facilities


with


a portfolio of power, cooling and IT infrastructure solutions and services that extends from the cloud to the edge of the network. Headquartered in Westerville, Ohio, USA, Vertiv does business in more than 130 countries. For more information, and for the latest news and content from Vertiv, visit


[Vertiv.com](https://www.vertiv.com/en-us/) .


### About King Environmental Services


King Environmental Services Ltd. (KES) is a Europe-based specialist in fluid management, flushing, commissioning and operational validation for high-density, liquid-cooled data centers and other mission-critical facilities. Founded in 2002 and headquartered near Dublin, Ireland, KES serves customers across EMEA from key hubs in North Dublin and Frankfurt. KES provides an integrated service covering design review and feasibility studies, pipework flushing, filtration and water treatment, testing, adjusting and balancing (TAB), data logging and thermography, and large-scale thermal and electrical load testing. The company bridges construction and live operation, validating that cooling systems are clean, balanced, efficient, design-compliant and ready for high-density and AI workloads.
